messages:
maya: Quick pre-launch sync — final RN for v1.24. EU change window 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC. Need ops pin, internal blast copy, and deploy-bot cue. Who can own pin+monitor?

sam: Ill handle rollback criteria + runbook. tagging @lee for ops lead.

lee: Ill own ops. Confirm pins: runtime-0.9.3 and model default redwood-neo-1.1-q8 for EU only, yes?

maya: Correct. Add RN note about quant toggle (non-breaking) and KV cache warmup.

natalie: Docs preview: https://redwood.internal.preview/1.24/embed-snippet. Suggest shorter headline: "Faster inference, lower cost — EU rollout"

maya: Nice. Add bullet under "What to watch": "Initial requests may see slightly higher latency for first 510 minutes as caches warm."

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduling deploy -> prod | env=eu-prod | version=runtime-0.9.3 | start=2026-03-22T00:30:00Z | canary=10% | auto-rollforward=false | notify=#eng-releases :robot_face:

sam: Rollback thresholds: p99 > 250ms sustained 10m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m -> rollback to runtime-0.9.2. Manual rollback if eval detects quality regression. I'll update runbook.

lee: I'll push route policy to pin model default and set canary split 10/90.

ops: Route + canary policy applied. cfg id cfg-eu-20260322-17. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24. Adding alerts.

natalie: Draft internal blast:
"Redwood v1.24 — EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. Deploying runtime-0.9.3 and pinning redwood-neo-1.1-q8 (EU only). Expect brief cache warmup. Oncall: lee, sam. Details: <doc>"

maya: Trimmed for staff post:
"Heads-up: v1.24 EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. Runtime: 0.9.3. Model: redwood-neo-1.1-q8 (EU only). Brief cache warmup possible. Oncall: lee, sam. Full notes: <doc>."

sam: Add contact list: lee (ops lead), sam (release owner), eng-sre oncall, docs (natalie).

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary started 2026-03-22T00:30:30Z — canary=10%. Metrics: p95=120ms p99=190ms error_rate=0.08%.

lee: Canary metrics look good. I'll watch 30m and 1h checks.

maya: Posting internal channel at 00:35 UTC. Leaving thread open for alerts.

ops: Alerting rule added with 2m digest to #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: Status update 2026-03-22T00:58:30Z — canary steady, no anomalies :white_check_mark:
